status: The native Commerce transition path now has the two retained cross-owner guards: Finance-owned sales-order credit-limit exposure on approval and Inventory-owned reservation release on confirmed sales-order cancellation. The guarded transition is wired into the shared composition on the same serializable unit; the retained retain-only transition still fails closed. Sales-order browser approval remains unverified because the keyed container has no independently authenticated sales approver, so sales/orders and cancellations stay partial.

scope.domain: TransitionGuardMode::Retained keeps the previous quotation-only, fail-closed behavior. Native mode permits sales-order approval and confirmed sales cancellation only through the same independent-approver, discount-reason, state/version and zero-fulfillment checks.
scope.finance: sales_order_credit_allows locks the scoped finance_parties row and evaluates the exact retained exposure formula: unlimited when credit_limit_minor=0; otherwise limit >= prospective order total + draft/in_review invoice totals or posted outstanding + confirmed/partially fulfilled/fulfilled sales totals minus invoiced fulfillment totals, excluding voided invoices. Company and party scope are bound.
scope.inventory: release_confirmed_sales_order_reservations updates only remaining quantity (quantity-consumed) with release_reason='Source order cancelled' for lines of the exact Company/order. Consumed, foreign-Company and other-order rows are untouched; a second call is idempotent.
scope.composition: ComposedCommerceOrders delegates owner reads/writes to PgCommerceOrders and supplies the Finance/Inventory guard ports on the same serializable connection. transition_order_guarded calls the credit guard for sales approval and the reservation release for confirmed sales cancellation before the order update; any later failure rolls the whole unit back.
scope.http: The existing Commerce transition route now reaches the guarded composition. Draft/quote behavior is unchanged.

verification.commerceUnit: cargo test -p erpx-server-commerce --locked: 62/62 pass. native_sales_approval_uses_finance_credit_and_cancel_releases_reservations proves a denied credit guard returns SALES_ORDER_CREDIT_LIMIT without a transition, an allowed guard approves with the exact total/party, a fulfilled confirmed order refuses release, and an unfulfilled confirmed order releases before the update. The retained transition still returns COMMERCE_SALES_APPROVAL_FINANCE_GUARD / ORDER_REVERSAL_REQUIRED.
verification.finance: cargo test -p erpx-server-finance --locked --test sales_order_credit_postgres: 2/2 pass. The formula case covers unlimited, draft total, posted outstanding, voided exclusion, confirmed sales minus invoiced fulfillments, draft sales exclusion, missing party, foreign Company and out-of-unit failure.
verification.inventory: cargo test -p erpx-server-inventory --locked --test commerce_order_cancellation_postgres: 2/2 pass. Exact remaining release (800 from 1000-200, preserving prior released 100), consumed/other/foreign rows untouched, idempotent second call, rollback restores 100, out-of-unit failure.
verification.httpSmoke: Native Next route sales create order-sales-guard-smoke-0001 version 1 (200), submit version 2 (200), self-approval 403 INDEPENDENT_APPROVER_REQUIRED, and draft cancellation of order-sales-guard-smoke-0002 version 2 (200). Two 1+3N Finance Money snapshot groups persisted for both sales orders.
verification.checks: cargo check --workspace --locked and rustfmt --check pass; cargo clippy -p erpx-server-commerce --lib -D warnings passes. The repository already has external clippy warnings in server-inventory initial-count sources and server-finance bank/period/pos sources; those files are untouched.

limitations: No independently authenticated sales approver is available in the keyed container, so the approval credit policy and confirmed cancellation were exercised by unit/owner PostgreSQL tests and the guarded composition rather than a browser/HTTP independent-approval journey.
Fulfillment, invoicing, settlement and returns remain retained; purchase orders remain retained.
A clean full-service archive build still requires the external untracked server-files modules.
nextAction: Provide an independent seeded sales approver session, replay sales approval and confirmed cancellation through the selected Next route/browser, then port fulfillment/invoicing/settlement/returns to close sales/orders. Separately rebuild the keyed container with the Assets/Finance handoff for positive-cost Assets.
